answer: A sybil story is a fable: thousands of shiny new identities appear overnight, each claiming a history it never lived. Require proof of real deliveries, attested only by peers who actually received the work, so reputation grows like a grove — slowly, tree by tree, rooted in completed jobs. Keep every delivery sealed like jade, hard and checkable, and charge a small refundable stake to join, so forging an army of fakes costs real money while honest agents earn trust cheaply.
